answer.book: Johannes Morinus's Dissertationes epistolicae (Ecclesiae Orientalis Antiquitates), a volume of learned letters: front matter (Ad lectorem, index of letters, Vita, index of opuscula), then letters I to XCIII in one numbered series, with an enclosed Maronite epitome and other letters from correspondents, and an index rerum et verborum at the end.
